biography: Rafael Simon, a name synonymous with unwavering defense and calculated aggression on the track, hails from the vibrant karting scene of Sao Paulo, Brazil. Growing up near Interlagos, the roar of engines was the soundtrack to his childhood. His father, a mechanic, introduced him to karting at age 8, sparking a passion that quickly outgrew the local circuit. Early on, Rafael displayed a remarkable talent for tire conservation and defensive driving, frustrating opponents with his uncanny ability to hold a line. A defining moment came at 16 during the Brazilian Karting Championship when, despite starting last after a mechanical issue, he clawed his way to second, showcasing his resilience. After winning the Brazilian Formula Regional series, Rafael was signed by MetalMoro, quickly adapting to the MRX Duratec Turbo P3 prototype. Now at 23, Rafael is considered a rising star in the world of endurance racing, consistently delivering solid results and proving a formidable opponent, his defensive style often forcing rivals into errors.
drivingStyle: Rafael's driving style is characterized by exceptional tire management and a defensive approach that prioritizes consistency and minimizing risk. He's not the flashiest driver, but he excels at maintaining a steady pace, conserving his tires, and capitalizing on the mistakes of others. In corners, he favors a smooth, controlled entry, maximizing exit speed while preserving tire life. Under pressure, Rafael remains remarkably calm, his defensive prowess amplified as he becomes an almost impenetrable wall on the track. He is a master of blocking and strategic positioning, often forcing his rivals to make risky maneuvers to overtake him.

rivalries.name: Enzo Bellini
rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry dating back to their karting days, Enzo is a more aggressive driver, often clashing with Rafael's defensive style.

rivalries.name: Isabela Costa
rivalries.reason: Isabela, known for her blistering pace, has often been frustrated by Rafael's ability to hold her off, leading to several on-track incidents.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: Kenji and Rafael have a strategic rivalry, each trying to outsmart the other with pit stop strategy and fuel management.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks given to him by his grandmother before every race.
Listens to a specific Brazilian samba song before getting into the car.
Spends 15 minutes visualizing the first lap of the race in his mind, focusing on defensive strategies.
famousQuote: "It's not about being the fastest, it's about being the smartest. The finish line doesn't care who led the most laps."
careerHighlight: Winning the 6 Hours of Interlagos in 2023 after a nail-biting final stint where he defended against relentless pressure from Enzo Bellini to secure the victory for MetalMoro.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the 2022 Brazilian Endurance Championship final race due to a mechanical failure, costing him the championship title.
